notice: Catalog distinguishes tested browser ports, partial translations, server-only components replaced by the static runtime, and Java/Android source that is not yet equivalent in the browser. GitHub Pages executes only the tested browser implementations; it does not run the Java server.

modules.functionality: Application router and scientific workbench endpoints
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Router HTTP Java tidak digunakan pada GitHub Pages; halaman dan research-core.js menggantikan dispatch browser.

modules.functionality: Earlier natural-language research workspace; retained as source reference
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Alur ide natural-language jadi inspirasi pemetaan kata kunci browser; bukan reasoning AI penuh.

modules.functionality: Core application services and shared scientific operations
modules.browserConnection: Propulsion ideal, screening material, Simpson integration, RK4, dan konversi unit tersedia melalui workflow core-calculation pada research-core.js.

modules.functionality: JSON parsing and serialization used across the research records
modules.browserConnection: Parsing/serialisasi JSON memakai JSON.parse/JSON.stringify; helper Java tidak dieksekusi di Pages.

modules.functionality: Central paths for local research and experiment storage
modules.browserStatus: Not applicable to static browser runtime
modules.browserConnection: Path filesystem Java digantikan penyimpanan lokal browser; tidak ada akses filesystem server.

modules.functionality: Read/write access to local datasets and research archives
modules.browserConnection: Impor CSV lokal browser via localStorage tersedia dengan batas 2 MB/5000 baris; repositori JSONL Java tidak tersedia.

modules.functionality: SI dimensional consistency and unit-aware checks
modules.browserConnection: Pemeriksaan dimensi SI untuk ekspresi dan persamaan kini tersedia di docs/engine/research.js; port mendukung basis SI, turunan dimensi umum, fungsi dimensionless, dan eksponen numerik.

modules.functionality: Physical constants and core physics relations
modules.browserConnection: Katalog konstanta/persamaan serta model roket dan panas di layer Fisika.

modules.functionality: Special-relativity calculations and metric-related routines
modules.browserConnection: Minkowski, Schwarzschild, Alcubierre reduced, Morris-Thorne, tensor Riemann/Ricci/Einstein finite-difference, convergence, signature, diagonal energy conditions, dan field residual tersedia; numerik sensitif pada step dan koordinat.

modules.functionality: Sensitivity, uncertainty propagation, and bounded Monte Carlo tools
modules.browserConnection: Kurva normal dan rentang ±1σ di browser; belum menjalankan Monte Carlo Java.

modules.functionality: Expression representation for symbolic calculations
modules.browserConnection: Parser aritmetika aman, evaluasi variabel, fungsi dasar, turunan dan integral terbatas tersedia di docs/engine/symbolic.js; belum mencakup seluruh API Java.

modules.functionality: Symbolic transformations and equation manipulation
modules.browserConnection: AST simbolik, penyederhanaan dasar, evaluasi, turunan/integral terbatas, substitusi variabel, dan isolasi persamaan dengan operasi invertibel terbatas tersedia di docs/engine/symbolic.js; seluruh edge case Java belum dipindahkan.

modules.functionality: Equation definitions, variables, units, and metadata
modules.browserConnection: Registri persamaan interaktif disimpan lokal pada browser, memvalidasi dimensi, menyertakan metadata sumber, serta ekspor/impor JSON; belum sinkron dengan penyimpanan file Java.

modules.functionality: Catalog of constants, equations, assumptions, and source references
modules.browserConnection: Konstanta, persamaan, asumsi, satuan, ketidakpastian, dan tautan sumber ditampilkan dari katalog browser.

modules.functionality: Material properties, conditions, source traceability, and unknown values
modules.browserConnection: Daftar properti material yang dipublikasikan; nilai hilang tetap UNKNOWN.

modules.functionality: Temperature/property curves and bounded interpolation
modules.browserConnection: Kurva properti terhadap suhu dengan batas rentang sumber; interpolasi dibatasi.

modules.functionality: Retrieval of public research records and open datasets
modules.browserConnection: Zenodo metadata search dan unduhan CSV publik tersedia via fetch browser; dibatasi 3 file, 2 MB/file, CORS, dan localStorage.

modules.functionality: Research cycle from idea/search through data intake and analysis
modules.browserConnection: Siklus browser mencari metadata Zenodo, mengimpor maksimal tiga CSV numerik, menyimpan lokal, lalu menjalankan screening model terbatas; belum melakukan seluruh derivasi persamaan/mesin Java.

modules.functionality: Repeatable analysis and candidate-model screening
modules.browserConnection: Analisis dataset lokal mencakup model polinomial derajat 1–4, logaritmik, resiprokal, eksponensial, power-law, dan cross-validation; pencarian multivariabel dan replikasi lintas-DOI belum setara.

modules.functionality: Automated candidate model exploration against baselines
modules.browserConnection: Pencarian feature grammar browser kini mencakup hingga empat predictor, fitur linear/kuadrat/eksponensial/log-abs, interaksi pasangan, kombinasi satu/dua term, dan cross-validation internal di docs/engine/autonomous-model.js; belum setara penuh untuk validasi independen dan perilaku Java lainnya.

modules.functionality: Discovery records and evidence tracking
modules.browserConnection: Pencarian kandidat satu variabel dan pencarian feature grammar multivariabel diterjemahkan; komposisi dua persamaan dengan isolasi variabel bersama, substitusi, dan pemeriksaan dimensi SI tersedia melalui workflow equation-composition; seluruh fit/edge case Java belum setara.

modules.functionality: Analytical reference cases, error checks, and benchmark reports
modules.browserConnection: 26 dari 27 kasus memiliki evaluator browser deterministik; flatness Minkowski sudah memakai metric solver browser. Benchmark Schwarzschild Ricci tetap INCONCLUSIVE karena benchmark Java meminta komponen ortonormal yang belum dipadankan.

modules.functionality: Separate classifications for mathematical/physical/engineering feasibility
modules.browserConnection: Klasifikasi bukti matematis/fisik/rekayasa tersedia melalui decision.js dan dipanggil oleh workflow assessment; klaim eksperimen tetap memerlukan metadata bukti mentah.

modules.functionality: Preliminary feasibility screening and conservation checks
modules.browserConnection: Staged assess() pipeline is translated in docs/engine/feasibility-assessment.js, including family routing (reaction/photon/spacetime/unimplemented), mathematical/conservation/energy-thermal/engineering stages, status precedence and report structure. MachineDesign.assemble() aggregation is also ported for imported component/material records. No Java filesystem persistence, local endpoints, metric-to-thrust model, or experimental verification.

modules.functionality: Component-level mass, power, energy, and heat aggregation
modules.browserConnection: MachineDesign.assemble() mass, power, energy, heat, missing-property and dependency aggregation is translated for user-imported components/materials in docs/engine/feasibility-assessment.js. Browser does not implement Java JSONL storage, add/edit/delete CRUD, or live MaterialDatabase lookup.

modules.functionality: Rocket propulsion and ideal reaction-propulsion calculations
modules.browserConnection: Generates and evaluates idealized reaction-propulsion candidates; bounded Isp/efficiency/duration sweep, ideal rocket relation, power/heat constraints and equation cross-checks. No hardware design.

modules.functionality: Energy-storage system screening and energy-density constraints
modules.browserConnection: Generates energy-density/efficiency combinations and evaluates ideal storage mass, input energy, conversion loss and user limits; no chemistry/device selection.

modules.functionality: Structural stress, strain, deformation, and buckling screening
modules.browserConnection: Generates section-scale candidates and screens von Mises stress plus ideal Euler buckling; inputs and material properties remain user-supplied.

modules.functionality: Thermal loads, conduction, radiation, and cooling screening
modules.browserConnection: Generates cooling-capacity candidates and evaluates steady-state conduction, Stefan–Boltzmann radiation and cooling margin.

modules.functionality: Links engineering constraints across multiple technology domains
modules.browserConnection: Urutan energy storage → thermal → structural diterjemahkan dengan transfer variabel eksplisit; bukan solver multiphysics penuh.

modules.functionality: Sequential multi-domain technology research workflow
modules.browserConnection: Gate empiris thrust-power, rentang daya teramati, syarat satuan N/W, cross-validation, dan penyaringan kandidat propulsion diterjemahkan; memakai model linear satu prediktor, bukan AutonomousModelExplorer multi-feature.

modules.functionality: Shared contract for technology-design domains
modules.browserConnection: Input maps, domain objectives, evaluation metrics, search spaces, equations, sources and limitations are represented by the browser domain contract.

modules.functionality: Registry of technology-design domain implementations
modules.browserConnection: All four registered Java domains are represented in the browser technology-design explorer.

modules.functionality: Coordinates technology-design calculations
modules.browserConnection: Shared candidate generation/evaluation, invalid-candidate accounting, feasible-envelope filtering and multi-objective Pareto front are available in docs/engine/technology-design.js.

modules.functionality: Explores candidate technology configurations
modules.browserConnection: Domain propulsion ideal dan penerapan batas empiris thrust-power pada kandidat dalam rentang observasi tersedia melalui technology-design.js dan research-core.js.

modules.functionality: Android entry point/adapter for the experimental mobile build
modules.browserConnection: Aplikasi Android tidak dijalankan pada GitHub Pages dan tetap berada di source Android.

modules.functionality: Immutable request contract for user questions, context and discipline hints
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Validasi request, context, hint disiplin, dan timestamp diterjemahkan ke research-core.js.

modules.functionality: Inspectable discipline routing and ordered engine execution steps
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Plan eksplisit, urutan langkah, engineId, dan rationale tersedia melalui research-core.js.

modules.functionality: Normalized source provenance, identifiers, licensing and verification metadata
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Normalisasi metadata sumber dan provenance diterjemahkan ke record sumber research-core.js.

modules.functionality: Normalized engine output, execution status, sources and limitations
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Kontrak hasil analisis, status, output, sumber, batasan, dan error diterjemahkan ke hasil dispatch browser.

modules.functionality: Evidence classification, validation checks, uncertainty and limitations
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Struktur laporan evidence konservatif diterjemahkan pada output research-core browser.

modules.functionality: Adapter interface for existing and future research engines
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Kontrak eksekusi engine diterjemahkan ke adapter dispatch browser; implementasi spesifik tetap mengikuti status workflow.

modules.functionality: Explicit registry for safe research engine selection
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Registry workflow browser menyediakan daftar mesin dan routing eksplisit tanpa reflection/server.

modules.functionality: Deterministic baseline planner; not an LLM reasoning layer
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Planner deterministik dengan workflow map dan inferensi disiplin diterjemahkan ke research-core.js.

modules.functionality: Conservative evidence evaluator that separates screening from validation
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Laporan bukti konservatif diterjemahkan; tidak menaikkan screening menjadi bukti eksperimen.

modules.functionality: Single dispatch coordinator for planning, execution and evidence review
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Dispatch, hasil langkah, status gagal, dan evidence report berjalan di browser.

modules.functionality: Adapters for existing open-data, deterministic dataset and integrated technology workflows
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Adapter workflow diterjemahkan untuk mesin browser yang tersedia; workflow integrated research dan siklus impor penuh masih terbatas.

modules.functionality: JSON HTTP endpoints for unified research dispatch and engine discovery
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Endpoint HTTP /research/dispatch dan /knowledge/graph tidak dipakai; retrieval Mnemos langsung dari browser.

modules.functionality: Replaceable interface for deterministic, LLM-backed or human-authored research planning
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Boundary planner diterjemahkan menjadi API plan() browser.

modules.functionality: Adapters for scientific catalog validation, symbolic math, special relativity, feasibility, numerical benchmarks, material selection, uncertainty, technology-domain and cross-domain workflows
modules.runtime: Java server; not executable on Pages
modules.browserConnection: Workflow browser tersedia untuk katalog, symbolic, special relativity, feasibility, benchmark, material screening, uncertainty, technology domain, cross-domain, metric geometry, engineering, dan open-data; beberapa tetap partial sesuai katalog.
